professionalSummary: Product manager with four years of experience leading the integrations area of a developer analytics suite, responsible for writing product requirements, conducting discovery with engineering leaders, prioritising backlog using a weighted scoring method, and reporting adoption to leadership.
experienceHighlights: Led discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts and authored product requirements for source control and ticketing integrations.
Prioritised the integrations backlog with the feature team using the suite's weighted scoring method, maintaining scoring sheets and quarterly roadmap reviews.
Reported integration adoption quarterly to the leadership team and documented roadmap boundaries for the integrations area.
Previously served as a business analyst for two years, writing requirement specifications for client systems.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Product requirements for the ticketing integration, weighted scoring sheet for one quarter, and adoption report for the same quarter, all stored in the product folder.
